name: Large-Scale 12-Lead Electrocardiogram Database for Arrhythmia Research
description: The Large-Scale 12-Lead Electrocardiogram Database is an extensive, open-access clinical electrophysiology collection published in Nature Scientific Data by Chapman University and Shaoxing People's Hospital, hosted on PhysioNet. The database contains 45,152 12-lead ECG recordings from 10,646 individual patients sampled at 500 Hz for 10 seconds per lead. All recordings are labeled by clinical experts across 11 rhythm categories (including atrial fibrillation, sinus tachycardia, sinus bradycardia, supraventricular tachycardia, and junctional rhythms) and 67 distinct arrhythmia and morphological cardiovascular conditions, providing an indispensable resource for multi-label arrhythmia classification and deep learning in cardiology.
